title: Machine Man #18 Marvel 1980 Early Alpha Flight Sasquatch Northstar Aurora Ditko
conditionDescription: Bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. See photos.
descriptionText:
Machine Man #18 (December 1980), Marvel Comics - "Enter Sasquatch, Northstar and Aurora -- Alpha Flight!" Early Alpha Flight appearance, tying into X-Men #140. Written by Tom DeFalco, art by Steve Ditko; cover by Rich Buckler and Simons. 50 cent cover price.

Back cover: LEGO Expert Builder Series ad.

Condition: bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
